Bimari, waba, jadu aur un-dekhi bala'on se bacha'o ki du'a**

Hazrat Jabir waghaira farmate hain Falaq kehte hain subh ko, khud Quran mein noor jagah hai "Faliq-ul-Isbah". Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se marwi hai Falaq se murad makhlooq hai, Hazrat Ka'b Ahbar farmate hain Falaq Jahannum mein ek jagah hai jab is ka darwaza khulta hai toh is ki aag garmi aur sakhti ki wajah se tamam Jahannami cheekhne lagte hain. Ek marfoo' hadith mein bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb marwi hai. Lekin woh hadith munkar hai. Yeh bhi ba'z log kehte hain ke yeh Jahannum ka naam hai. Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain ke sab se ziyada theek qaul pehla hi hai ya'ni murad is se subh hai. Imam Bukhari (Rahimahullah / R.H) bhi yehi farmate hain aur yehi sahih hai. Tamam makhlooq ki bura'i se jis mein Jahannum bhi dakhil hai aur Iblees aur aulad-e-Iblees bhi.

Ghasiaq se murad raat hai. "Iza waqab" se murad sooraj ka ghuroob ho jana hai, ya'ni raat jab andhera liye hu'e aa ja'e, Ibn Zaid kehte hain ke Arab Surayya sitare ke ghuroob hone ko Ghasiaq kehte hain. Bimariyan aur wabayein is ke waqi' hone ke waqt barh jati theen aur is ke tuloo' hone ke waqt uth jati theen. Ek marfoo' hadith mein hai ke sitara Ghasiaq hai, lekin is ka marfoo' hona sahih nahin, ba'z mufassireen kehte hain murad is se chand hai, un ki daleel Musnad Ahmad ki yeh hadith hai jis mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) ka hath thame hu'e chand ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya Allah Ta'ala se is Ghasiaq ki bura'i se panah mang aur riwayat mein hai ke "Ghasiaqin iza waqab" se yehi murad hai, donon qaulon mein ba-asani yeh tatbeeq ho sakti hai ke chand ka charhna aur sitaron ka zahir hona waghaira, yeh sab raat hi ke waqt hota hai jab raat aa ja'e, Wallahu A'lam.

Girah laga kar phoonkne waliyon se murad jadugar aurtein hain, Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain shirk ke bilkul qareeb woh mantar hain jinhein parh kar saanp ke kate par dam kiya jata hai aur aaseeb-zadah par. Doosri hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Jibra'eel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha kya Aap beemar hain? Aap ne farmaya han toh Hazrat Jibra'eel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne yeh du'a parhi ya'ni Allah Ta'ala ke naam se mein dam karta hoon har is bimari se jo tujhe dukh pohanchaye aur har hasid ki bura'i aur badi se Allah tujhe shifa de. Is bimari se murad shayad woh bimari hai jabke Aap par jadu kiya gaya tha phir Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ko 'afiyat aur shifa bakhshi aur hasid Yahudiyon ke jadugar ke makr ko radd kar diya aur un ki tadbeeron ko be-asar kar diya aur unhein ruswa aur fazeehat kiya, lekin ba-wujud is ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kabhi bhi apne oopar jadu karne wale ko danta dapta tak nahin Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ki kifayat ki aur Aap ko 'afiyat aur shifa 'ata farma'i. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par ek Yahudi ne jadu kiya jis se ka'i din tak Aap beemar rahe phir Hazrat Jibra'eel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne aa kar bataya ke falan Yahudi ne Aap par jadu kiya hai aur falan falan kunwein mein girhein laga kar rakh rakha hai Aap kisi ko bhej kar ise nikalwa lijeiye.

Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aadmi bheja aur us kunwein se woh jaadu nikalwa kar girhein khool dein saara asar jaata raha phir na to Aap ne us yahoodi se kabhi is ka zikr kiya aur na kabhi us ke saamne gusse ka izhaar kiya, Sahih Bukhari Shareef Kitab-ut-Tibb mein Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jaadu kiya gaya Aap samajhte the ke Aap azwaj-e-mutahharat ke paas aaye haalanke na aaye the, Hazrat Sufyan farmate hain yahi sab se bada jaadu ka asar hai, jab yeh haalat Aap ki ho gayi ek din Aap farmane lage Aisha mein ne apne Rab se poochha aur mere Parwardigar ne bata diya do shakhs aaye ek mere sarhane ek paayenton ki taraf, sarhane wale ne us doosre se poochha in ka kya haal hai? doosre ne kaha in par jaadu kiya gaya hai poochha kis ne jaadu kiya hai? kaha Ubaid bin A'sam ne jo Banu Razeeq ke qabile ka hai jo yahood ka haleef hai aur munafiq shakhs hai, kaha kis cheez mein? kaha tar khajoor ke darakht ki chhaal mein pattthar ki chataan tale Zarwan ke kunwein mein, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us kunwein ke paas aaye aur us mein se woh nikalwaya us ka paani aisa tha goya mehndi ka gudla paani us ke paas ke khajooron ke darakht shaitanon ke sar jaise the, mein ne kaha bhi ke ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) inse badla lena chahiye Aap ne farmaya Alhamdulillah Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe to shifa de di aur mein logon mein burai phailana pasand nahin karta, doosri riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke ek kaam karte na the aur us ke asar se yeh maloom hota tha ke goya mein kar chuka hoon aur yeh bhi hai ke us kunwein ko Aap ke hukm se band kar diya gaya, yeh bhi marwi hai ke chhah mahine tak Aap ki yahi haalat rahi, Tafseer-e-Sa'labi mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas aur Hazrat Umm-ul-Mo'mineen Aisha (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) se marwi hai ke yahood ka ek baccha Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat kiya karta tha usay yahoodiyon ne behka sikha kar Aap ke chand baal aur Aap ki kanghi ke chand dandane mangwa liye aur un mein jaadu kiya is kaam mein zyada tar koshish karne wala Lubaid bin A'sam tha phir Zarwan naami kunwein mein jo Banu Zuraik ka tha usay daal diya pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) beemar ho gaye sar ke baal jhadne lage khayal aata tha ke mein auraton ke paas ho aaya haalanke aate na the go Aap isay door karne ki koshish mein the lekin wajah maloom na hoti thi chhah maah tak yahi haal raha phir woh waqia hua jo oopar bayan kiya ke farishtan ke zariye Aap ko is ka tamam haal ilm ho gaya aur Aap ne Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Zubair aur Hazrat Ammar bin Yasir (Razi Allahu Anhum / R.A) ko bhej kar kunwein mein se woh sab cheezein nikalwain un mein ek taant thi jis mein barah girhein lagi hui theen aur har girah par ek sooi chhabhi hui thi, phir Allah Ta'ala ne yeh donon surtein utareen, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek ek aayat in ki padhte jaate the aur ek ek girah is ki khud-ba-khud khulti jaati thi, jab yeh donon surtein poori huin woh sab girhein khul gain aur Aap bilkul shifayab ho gaye, idhar Jibreel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne woh dua padhi jo oopar guzar chuki hai, logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamein ijazat dijeeye ke hum is khabeeth ko pakad kar qatl kar dein Aap ne farmaya nahin Allah ne mujhe to tandurusti de di aur mein logon mein shar-o-fasaad phailana nahin chahta.

Yeh riwayat Tafsir-e-Sa'labi mein bila sanad marwi hai, is mein gharabat bhi hai aur is ke ba'az hisse mein sakht nakarat hai aur ba'az ke shawahid bhi hain jo pehle bayan ho chuke hain, Wallahu A'lam.

chhabhi hui thi, phir Allah Ta'ala ne yeh donon surtein utareen, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek ek aayat in ki padhte jaate the aur ek ek girah is ki khud-ba-khud khulti jaati thi, jab yeh donon surtein poori huin woh sab girhein khul gain aur Aap bilkul shifayab ho gaye, idhar Jibreel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne woh dua padhi jo oopar guzar chuki hai, logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamein ijazat dijeeye ke hum is khabeeth ko pakad kar qatl kar dein Aap ne farmaya nahin Allah ne mujhe to tandurusti de di aur mein logon mein shar-o-fasaad phailana nahin chahta.

Yeh riwayat Tafsir-e-Sa'labi mein bila sanad marwi hai, is mein gharabat bhi hai aur is ke ba'az hisse mein sakht nakarat hai aur ba'az ke shawahid bhi hain jo pehle bayan ho chuke hain, Wallahu A'lam.

Bimari, waba, jadu aur un-dekhi bala'on se bacha'o ki du'a**

Hazrat Jabir waghaira farmate hain Falaq kehte hain subh ko, khud Quran mein noor jagah hai "Faliq-ul-Isbah". Ibn Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se marwi hai Falaq se murad makhlooq hai, Hazrat Ka'b Ahbar farmate hain Falaq Jahannum mein ek jagah hai jab is ka darwaza khulta hai toh is ki aag garmi aur sakhti ki wajah se tamam Jahannami cheekhne lagte hain. Ek marfoo' hadith mein bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb marwi hai. Lekin woh hadith munkar hai. Yeh bhi ba'z log kehte hain ke yeh Jahannum ka naam hai. Imam Ibn Jarir (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain ke sab se ziyada theek qaul pehla hi hai ya'ni murad is se subh hai. Imam Bukhari (Rahimahullah / R.H) bhi yehi farmate hain aur yehi sahih hai. Tamam makhlooq ki bura'i se jis mein Jahannum bhi dakhil hai aur Iblees aur aulad-e-Iblees bhi.

Ghasiaq se murad raat hai. "Iza waqab" se murad sooraj ka ghuroob ho jana hai, ya'ni raat jab andhera liye hu'e aa ja'e, Ibn Zaid kehte hain ke Arab Surayya sitare ke ghuroob hone ko Ghasiaq kehte hain. Bimariyan aur wabayein is ke waqi' hone ke waqt barh jati theen aur is ke tuloo' hone ke waqt uth jati theen. Ek marfoo' hadith mein hai ke sitara Ghasiaq hai, lekin is ka marfoo' hona sahih nahin, ba'z mufassireen kehte hain murad is se chand hai, un ki daleel Musnad Ahmad ki yeh hadith hai jis mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) ka hath thame hu'e chand ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya Allah Ta'ala se is Ghasiaq ki bura'i se panah mang aur riwayat mein hai ke "Ghasiaqin iza waqab" se yehi murad hai, donon qaulon mein ba-asani yeh tatbeeq ho sakti hai ke chand ka charhna aur sitaron ka zahir hona waghaira, yeh sab raat hi ke waqt hota hai jab raat aa ja'e, Wallahu A'lam.

Girah laga kar phoonkne waliyon se murad jadugar aurtein hain, Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain shirk ke bilkul qareeb woh mantar hain jinhein parh kar saanp ke kate par dam kiya jata hai aur aaseeb-zadah par. Doosri hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Jibra'eel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha kya Aap beemar hain? Aap ne farmaya han toh Hazrat Jibra'eel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne yeh du'a parhi ya'ni Allah Ta'ala ke naam se mein dam karta hoon har is bimari se jo tujhe dukh pohanchaye aur har hasid ki bura'i aur badi se Allah tujhe shifa de. Is bimari se murad shayad woh bimari hai jabke Aap par jadu kiya gaya tha phir Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ko 'afiyat aur shifa bakhshi aur hasid Yahudiyon ke jadugar ke makr ko radd kar diya aur un ki tadbeeron ko be-asar kar diya aur unhein ruswa aur fazeehat kiya, lekin ba-wujud is ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kabhi bhi apne oopar jadu karne wale ko danta dapta tak nahin Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ki kifayat ki aur Aap ko 'afiyat aur shifa 'ata farma'i. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par ek Yahudi ne jadu kiya jis se ka'i din tak Aap beemar rahe phir Hazrat Jibra'eel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne aa kar bataya ke falan Yahudi ne Aap par jadu kiya hai aur falan falan kunwein mein girhein laga kar rakh rakha hai Aap kisi ko bhej kar ise nikalwa lijeiye.

Aanhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aadmi bheja aur us kunwein se woh jaadu nikalwa kar girhein khool dein saara asar jaata raha phir na to Aap ne us yahoodi se kabhi is ka zikr kiya aur na kabhi us ke saamne gusse ka izhaar kiya, Sahih Bukhari Shareef Kitab-ut-Tibb mein Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jaadu kiya gaya Aap samajhte the ke Aap azwaj-e-mutahharat ke paas aaye haalanke na aaye the, Hazrat Sufyan farmate hain yahi sab se bada jaadu ka asar hai, jab yeh haalat Aap ki ho gayi ek din Aap farmane lage Aisha mein ne apne Rab se poochha aur mere Parwardigar ne bata diya do shakhs aaye ek mere sarhane ek paayenton ki taraf, sarhane wale ne us doosre se poochha in ka kya haal hai? doosre ne kaha in par jaadu kiya gaya hai poochha kis ne jaadu kiya hai? kaha Ubaid bin A'sam ne jo Banu Razeeq ke qabile ka hai jo yahood ka haleef hai aur munafiq shakhs hai, kaha kis cheez mein? kaha tar khajoor ke darakht ki chhaal mein pattthar ki chataan tale Zarwan ke kunwein mein, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us kunwein ke paas aaye aur us mein se woh nikalwaya us ka paani aisa tha goya mehndi ka gudla paani us ke paas ke khajooron ke darakht shaitanon ke sar jaise the, mein ne kaha bhi ke ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) inse badla lena chahiye Aap ne farmaya Alhamdulillah Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe to shifa de di aur mein logon mein burai phailana pasand nahin karta, doosri riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke ek kaam karte na the aur us ke asar se yeh maloom hota tha ke goya mein kar chuka hoon aur yeh bhi hai ke us kunwein ko Aap ke hukm se band kar diya gaya, yeh bhi marwi hai ke chhah mahine tak Aap ki yahi haalat rahi, Tafseer-e-Sa'labi mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas aur Hazrat Umm-ul-Mo'mineen Aisha (Razi Allahu Anha / R.A) se marwi hai ke yahood ka ek baccha Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat kiya karta tha usay yahoodiyon ne behka sikha kar Aap ke chand baal aur Aap ki kanghi ke chand dandane mangwa liye aur un mein jaadu kiya is kaam mein zyada tar koshish karne wala Lubaid bin A'sam tha phir Zarwan naami kunwein mein jo Banu Zuraik ka tha usay daal diya pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) beemar ho gaye sar ke baal jhadne lage khayal aata tha ke mein auraton ke paas ho aaya haalanke aate na the go Aap isay door karne ki koshish
